daily_reality.typical_day: Insurance agents start at 8:30 AM. Morning (7-9 AM): review schedule, check emails, browse news. Mid-morning (9-11 AM): phone calls to clients/prospects. Late morning (11 AM-1 PM): client meetings, lunch appointments. Afternoon (1-3 PM): paperwork, marketing materials. Late afternoon (3-5 PM): more calls, research, proposal prep.
daily_reality.key_tasks: Prospecting and lead generation (calling overnight leads), client meetings to discuss insurance needs, administrative work (paperwork, policy processing, CRM updates), email management, time-blocking by task type or region.
daily_reality.work_hours: Typically 8:30 AM start, end times vary by season. Schedule flexibility based on client availability.

regulatory.licensing: All states require producer license. Must complete educational courses and pass exam before applying. Each state has its own Department of Insurance (DOI), licensing requirements, renewal processes.
regulatory.compliance_trends_2025_2026: 757 regulatory changes tracked in 2025 across US. 2026: NAIC Uniform Application updates, expanded electronic submission requirements. NAIC Uniform Licensing Technology Framework (ULTF) introduced in 2026. 92%+ states require online portals for renewal by mid-2026.
regulatory.emerging_areas: Stricter data security and management protocols. AML rules expanding to annuities, life insurance, cash-value policies.

tools.ams_platforms: Applied Epic (large-scale), AMS360, QQCatalyst, HawkSoft, NowCerts. Vertafore offers AMS360 and QQCatalyst (widely used, automate billing, policy lifecycle, compliance).
tools.crm_platforms: Zoho (flexible, supports sales/service/marketing), AgencyBloc (life/health, CRM + commissions + workflow), Assur3d (all-in-one for brokers), EZLynx (comparative rater + AMS + CRM with AI), Foliume (AI platform, integrates with CRM/AMS), Strada (Salesforce integration).
tools.integration_strategy: AMS runs agency, CRM grows it. Agencies integrating both effectively in 2026 have competitive advantage.

market.market_insights: Salaries vary by location, experience, insurance type. NY and CA higher than less populated areas.

automation_potential.tasks_automated: Submission processing, policy checking, client communications (manual document handling down 75%, claims resolution 30d → 7.5d, routine claims 7-10d → 24-48h, policy verification 15-20min → seconds).
automation_potential.tasks_augmented: Automated claims ecosystems with triage + damage assessment + automated payments for simple claims, human-in-the-loop for complex cases (negotiation, empathy).
automation_potential.market_growth: AI in insurance: $8.63B in 2025, CAGR 27.32%, $59.5B by 2033. Insurers using AI agents: cost reduction 30%, policy issuance accelerated 40%, revenue increase 50%+ in specific cases.
automation_potential.outlook_2026: McKinsey: AI will reshape existing models, not disintermediate. AI will not kill brokers.

compliance_calendar.renewal_cycle: Biennial in most states. 92%+ states require online portals by mid-2026. NIPR Compliance Sync API 2.0 enables real-time CE, appointment, background check updates.
compliance_calendar.state_specific_2026: Georgia (Apr 1): new resident applications via state system. Guam (Apr 1-Jun 30): appointment renewal invoices. New Jersey (Apr 1-Jun 3): appointment renewal invoices, Mar 25 termination deadline.
compliance_calendar.regulatory_pace: 757 changes in 2025, pace not slowing in 2026. NAIC Uniform Application updates, expanded electronic submissions.

error_patterns.compliance_violations: Selling in unlicensed states, failing to renew licenses/CE on time, ignoring state-specific forms/disclosures.
error_patterns.professional_service_errors: Unfulfilled duties (failing to file paperwork), forgetting to inform clients about essential coverage (coverage gaps).
error_patterns.misrepresentation: Most frequent violation (intentional or accidental). Incorrect advice, failing to recommend appropriate coverage, misrepresenting policy terms, missing deadlines, paperwork errors, not explaining exclusions.
error_patterns.health_insurance_marketplace: Clients waiting until last minute during Open Enrollment Period, risking deadline miss and financial help loss.
error_patterns.operational_issues: Licensed team members handling non-licensed tasks. Too many people in client info flow (communication errors). Should assign agents to specific clients for full process.
error_patterns.coverage_gaps: E&O insurance excludes issues agent knew before policy. Basic E&O often excludes/limits data breaches and cyber incidents.
